message: I remember one winter during a surprise snowstorm, I was all set with my cozy blankets and hot cocoa, ready to hunker down. But just as I was about to check the weather updates, my phone decided it was the perfect moment to die. I learned the hard way that having a good old-fashioned battery-operated radio can be just as handy as the latest smartphone. Now I keep one in the cupboard, right next to the cocoa. You never know when the tech will take a little nap! 📻
